title: Sara Bleykli Spanx'ni 5000 dollar jamg'arma bilan boshlagan

scenes.text: 2000 yilda Sara Bleykli 5000 dollarlik jamg'armasi bilan Spanx'ni ishga tushirdi.
scenes.keywords: young woman working laptop small apartment

scenes.text: Bungacha u faks apparatlarini eshikma-eshik yurib sotardi.
Mahsulotini do'konlarga o'zi qo'ng'iroq qilib, o'zi borib taklif qildi.
2012 yilda Forbes uni o'z kuchi bilan milliarder bo'lgan eng yosh ayol deb atadi.
Ba'zan boshlash uchun qo'lingdagi bor narsa yetadi.

description: Sara Bleykli 5000 dollarlik jamg'armasi bilan 2000 yilda Spanx'ni ishga tushirdi; 2012 yilda Forbes uni o'z kuchi bilan milliarder bo'lgan eng yosh ayol deb atadi. Bungacha u faks apparatlari sotgan. Sen qo'lingdagi bor narsa bilan nimani boshlay olasan?
source: Forbes: Undercover Billionaire: Sara Blakely Joins The Rich List Thanks To Spanx (7 March 2012; youngest self-made woman on the list, at 41), https://www.forbes.com/sites/clareoconnor/2012/03/07/undercover-billionaire-sara-blakely-joins-the-rich-list-thanks-to-spanx/ ; Forbes: How Sara Blakely of Spanx Turned $5,000 into $1 billion (2012; set aside $5,000 savings, two years of planning, hosiery mill cold calls, Neiman Marcus pitch), https://www.forbes.com/global/2012/0326/billionaires-12-feature-united-states-spanx-sara-blakely-american-booty.html ; Forbes (2021): $5,000 savings from door-to-door fax machine sales, brand started in 2000, https://www.forbes.com/sites/elizahaverstock/2021/10/20/sara-blakely-is-a-billionaire-again-after-selling-a-majority-of-spanx-to-blackstone/ . Note: she set the $5,000 aside in 1998 and launched in 2000; the script says 'ishga tushirdi' in 2000.
